scripts:
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/oauth
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/oauth/clients
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/oauth/codes
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/oauth/tokens

create service user studio-oauth-service
set ACL for studio-oauth-service
    allow jcr:all on /var/studio/oauth
    allow jcr:read on /home
end

set ACL for everyone
    deny jcr:all on /var/studio/oauth
end
